papers.title_en: PanoUAV-Track: Full-Spherical UAV Visual Tracking in the Wild
papers.authors: Bingyu Li, Lichang Yang, Zhiyuan Zhao, Junyu Gao, Xuelong Li
papers.evidence: 全景视频序列上的无人机视觉跟踪基准
papers.tldr: 现有无人机跟踪基准多依赖视野受限的透视相机，全向相机下的运动平台跟踪仍鲜有探索。作者采集约40小时8K全景无人机视频，经时序片段提取、目标标注与仿真序列融合构建PanoUAV-Track基准，包含1895个序列与五十余万帧。该基准揭示等距柱状投影下的几何挑战，为全球面视觉目标跟踪提供评测平台与新研究方向。
papers.abstract_en: Existing UAV tracking benchmarks predominantly rely on perspective cameras with limited fields of view. Omnidirectional cameras enable full-spherical observation, yet tracking from moving UAV platforms remains largely unexplored. Unlike ground-level panoramic tracking, UAV-mounted omnidirectional cameras observe targets across both azimuth and elevation, introducing geometric challenges under equirectangular projection (ERP). To investigate this setting, we capture approximately \textbf{40 hours of real-world 8K panoramic UAV video} and construct \textbf{PanoUAV-Track} through temporal clip extraction, target annotation, and the integration of simulated sequences. The resulting benchmark comprises 1,895 sequences, 507,961 frames, and 2,872 annotated objects, covering real-world daytime and nighttime scenes alongside simulation, and supporting both visual and language-based target specification. Through extensive evaluations, we reveal a clear \textbf{perspective-to-spherical} generalization gap and identify tracking degradation associated with latitude-dependent distortion and ERP seam discontinuity. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{PanoUAV-Tracker (PUTrack)}, a geometry-aware tracking framework combining latitude-adaptive search and seam-aware periodic sampling. PUTrack improves zero-shot and in-domain tracking, particularly for seam-crossing targets. Code and benchmark resources will be available\footnote{\textcolor{tabpink}{https://libingyu01.github.io/PanoUAV-Track/}}.

papers.title_en: Distractors are the Real Enemy: Visual Distraction Adversarial Perturbations on SAM2-Based Video Tracking and Segmentation
papers.authors: Adonay Demewez Gebremedhin, Mohamad Alansari, Wessam Shehieb, Muzammal Naseer
papers.evidence: 针对SAM2视频跟踪与分割的干扰物对抗扰动攻击
papers.tldr: 针对SAM2等可提示视频跟踪器在对抗扰动下鲁棒性认识不足的问题，本文提出DistractAttack白盒攻击方法。作者观察到SAM2在跟踪不确定时会暴露干扰物线索，据此构造利用竞争目标干扰的对抗扰动，破坏其长期时序动态与掩码质量。实验表明该攻击能显著降低SAM2类视频跟踪与分割模型的性能。该工作揭示了视频目标跟踪与分割模型的脆弱性，对提升其鲁棒性具有参考价值。
papers.abstract_en: Promptable video trackers such as SAM2 achieve accurate and robust performance through strong temporal consistency, making them important foundations for downstream video understanding and tracking applications. As their use continues to expand, understanding their robustness to adversarial perturbations becomes increasingly important. Existing attacks on SAM2 largely focus on local mask degradation and short-term temporal feature disruption, leaving its longer-term dynamics and competing object interferences (Distractors) insufficiently explored. We observe that SAM2 itself exposes useful distractor cues when tracking becomes uncertain. Based on these observations, we propose DistractAttack, a white-box attack that uses background distractors to disrupt target tracking persistently. Its core procedure, Counterfactual Distractor Search (CDS), propagates clean and attacked trajectories in parallel to discover plausible competing regions and identify those that become increasingly effective under perturbation. The discovered evidence is accumulated over time to weaken target support and promote recurrent alternatives or disappearance predictions. Extensive experiments under video-level and one-shot perturbations across Visual Object Tracking and Video Object Segmentation demonstrate strong attack effectiveness, raising DRE to $4.4\times$ and NRE to $7.3\times$ their nearest baselines under video perturbation, while transferring effectively across model scales and tracker variants in black-box settings. Project page: https://adonaydem.github.io/sam2-da-page/

papers.evidence: 使用单个或多个相机在图像序列中跟踪刚体目标
papers.tldr: 该文研究如何利用单个或多个相机在图像序列中跟踪刚体目标。方法将三维模型表示与图像轮廓对齐，通过最小化预测模型点与图像轮廓的误差形成视觉伺服闭环，并在每次采集时更新相机内外参。作者深入分析最小化过程的雅可比矩阵，给出所需最少匹配数及导致秩亏的奇异构型，为多相机刚体跟踪提供理论基础。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we describe a method for tracking rigid objects using one or several cameras. The tracking process consists of aligning a 3-D model representation of an object with image contours by measuring and minimizing the image error between predicted model points and image contours. The tracker behaves like a visual servo loop where the internal and external camera parameters are updated at each new image acquisition. We study in detail the Jacobian matrix associated with this minimization process in the presence of both point-to-point and point-to-contour matches. We establish the minimal number of matches that are needed as well as the singular configurations leading to a rank-defficient Jacobian matrix. We find a mathematical link between the point-to-point and point-to-contour cases. Based on this link we show that the latter has the same kind of singularities than the former. Moreover, we study multiple camera configurations which optimize the robustness of the method in the presence of single-camera singularities, bad, noisy, or missing data. Extensive experiments done with a complex ship part and with up to three cameras validate the method. In particular we show that the tracker may well be used as a camera calibration procedure.

papers.title_en: Tracking Objects Through Assembly and Decomposition
papers.authors: Cheryl Lam, Yihong Sun, Bharath Hariharan
papers.evidence: 在视频中跟踪多物体及其状态变化
papers.tldr: 传统视频目标跟踪依赖初始物体提示且仅能检测分解事件，难以处理从多个物体开始的组装过程。作者提出无提示的任务形式，并设计零样本系统Atlas，将组装视为分解的逆过程，联合推理正向与反向的时空划分以恢复所有物体轨迹。实验表明该方法无需提示即可同时检测分解与组装事件并恢复轨迹，拓展了视频目标跟踪对状态变化的建模能力。
papers.abstract_en: Tracking objects through transformations is essential for understanding real-world dynamics. Recent work has extended traditional object tracking to detect state changes. However, existing methods require an initial object prompt and detect only its decompositions, missing assembly events, which begin with multiple objects rather than one. We therefore introduce a prompt-free formulation of this task, where the goal is to recover all object tracks and detect both decomposition and assembly events given only a video. Our key insight is that assembly is decomposition in reverse. Building on this insight, we present Atlas, a zero-shot system that constructs and jointly reasons over forward and reverse spatiotemporal partitions to recover object tracks and their transformations. We further introduce OmniST, a benchmark with dense annotations of objects and both transformation types. On OmniST, Atlas recovers more than twice as many state changes as prior methods while remaining competitive on existing benchmarks that only evaluate decomposition.

papers.title_en: Taking Apart and Putting Together: Tracking Objects Through Physical Transformations
papers.authors: Davide Gardenal, Mingxuan Liu, Flavio Vella, Quentin Guimard, Elisa Ricci
papers.evidence: 将视频目标跟踪扩展到经历物理变换的目标
papers.tldr: 当视频中的目标发生物理组装或拆分时，现有跟踪方法只能维持表观轨迹而无法更新目标的语义身份，导致跟踪失效。本文提出免训练的TIPO框架，通过候选提议与重叠关系持续推断目标变换、识别新实体并维护关系状态图。该工作将视频目标跟踪拓展到目标物理演化场景，为动态实体跟踪提供了新的任务设定与方法基础。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Transformation Tracking and Understanding (TTU), extending video object tracking to environments where objects undergo physical assemblies and disassemblies. TTU requires continuously tracking objects through transformations, identifying new entities, maintaining a state graph of their relationships, and assigning semantic labels to transformations. While foundation models (e.g., SAM 2/3) maintain tracklets through appearance changes, they cannot update semantic identities as objects physically evolve. Prior work addresses only disassemblies, relying on expensive searches triggered only when tracking fails. We propose Tracking Instances via Proposals and Overlaps (TIPO), a training-free framework that continuously infers transformations via a generate-evaluate-judge pipeline. TIPO generates split and merge proposals from disjoint mask components, scores them against mask-decoder priors using inner and external overlap, and queries an MLLM on the top proposal for visual verification and semantic labeling. To benchmark TTU, we curate Video Instances, States, and Transformation Annotations (VISTA), a dataset including state graphs with 124 assembly and 132 disassembly events across 50 sequences and over 26,000 frames. TIPO achieves state-of-the-art tracking and state-graph accuracy on VISTA, while operating $6\times$ to $15\times$ faster than prior methods. Project page: https://davidegardenal.github.io/tipo-tracking

papers.title_en: E-MAPS: Event-Based Promptable Video Segmentation with Memory-as-Prompt
papers.authors: Adonay Demewez Gebremedhin, Mohamad Alansari, Wessam Shehieb, Muzammal Naseer, Hasan AlMarzouqi, Sajid Javed, Naoufel Werghi
papers.evidence: 面向事件流的可提示视频目标分割
papers.tldr: 基于RGB的视频目标分割在快速运动和不良光照下表现脆弱，事件相机虽能保留信号但慢速时缺乏证据。作者形式化事件可提示视频分割任务，提出E-MAPS，将预训练可提示分割器迁移到事件流，并用Event-to-Token对齐循环事件特征、学习传播与校正。该方法允许在任意时间窗通过提示初始化、修正或引入目标，在挑战性条件下实现更稳健的视频目标分割。
papers.abstract_en: RGB-based video object segmentation (VOS) remains brittle under fast motion and adverse illumination. Event cameras preserve signal under blur and challenging exposure, but provide little evidence when motion slows. Interaction can restore object state for subsequent propagation, yet promptable event methods merely address single windows. We formalize event-based Promptable Video Segmentation (ePVS), where prompts at arbitrary windows initialize, correct, or introduce objects and predictions. We present Event Memory-As-Prompt Segmentation (E-MAPS), which transfers a pretrained promptable segmenter to event streams and learns propagation and correction. Event-to-Token (E2T) aligns recurrent event features with pretrained representations while preserving prompt-conditioning priors. Memory-Aware Prompting (MAP) converts object-conditioned history into sparse prompts, allowing memory and user inputs to share one decoder pathway efficiently. We construct Event-View Masklets (EViM) from 206K aligned RGB-event pairs and 620K masks for two-stage representation transfer and native event-video learning, and establish three training-disjoint benchmarks. E-MAPS leads prompt-once and interactive ePVS across all three benchmarks while being more efficient. It further demonstrates strong performance on zero-shot object tracking benchmarks. Project page: https://github.com/adonaydem/emaps-wacv

papers.title_en: Focus Only on What's Important: Training-Free Focus Maps for Frozen Vision Transformers in Long-Video Object Segmentation
papers.evidence: 面向长视频的高效视频目标分割
papers.tldr: 视觉Transformer是视频目标分割中强大但昂贵的图像编码器，而无训练token合并会均匀削减计算，连被跟踪目标也一并降采样。作者为冻结的DINOv3 ViT与Cutie分割头引入无训练焦点图，在目标区域保持全分辨率、背景采用粗合并，并用速度位移与块匹配掩码的并集及相机补偿的意外检测应对长视频中的快速运动。该方法避免了仅保护上一帧掩码在长视频中失效的问题，在保持分割质量的同时降低计算开销。
papers.abstract_en: Vision transformers are strong but costly image encoders for video object segmentation. Training-free token merging cuts compute uniformly across the frame, including on tracked objects. We give a frozen DINOv3 ViT inside a trained Cutie head a training-free focus map: full resolution where the segmenter expects its objects and coarser merging elsewhere. Protecting only the previous frame's mask works on short clips but fails on long videos, where fast motion pushes targets outside the margin and into background merging, locking in loss. Our policy instead takes the union of velocity-shifted and block-matched masks, runs a camera-compensated surprise check, delegates uncertain regions to the compared merger, and falls back to it when all objects are lost. On long videos (LVOS V2 valid, pre-specified protocol, three ViT-S seeds), it beats ALGM 0.98 by +2.76 J&F (95% object CI [+1.22,+4.44]; video-cluster [+0.99,+4.52]) at 16% fewer counted encoder FLOPs (0.385 vs. 0.459), sitting 1.0 J&F point below the dense-encoder baseline; at ViT-B the gain over ALGM 0.95 is +3.89 [+2.03,+5.87]. On DAVIS 2017 val it stays within -0.19 J&F of the dense encoder at ViT-S (-0.12 at ViT-B). Controls qualify the result: protecting only the previous mask under ALGM matches or exceeds accuracy at higher FLOPs (0.486), so expectation and surprise mainly reduce counted encoder compute. Practically, lower counted encoder compute did not reduce startup-inclusive mean Cutie step time on a 12-video LVOS sample (3%-8% lower in steady state; an equally engineered ALGM is faster at ViT-S and ViT-B). Section 5.2 separately examines a Cutie permanent-memory schedule and its latency and memory trade-offs. Code: https://github.com/boletoms/focused-cv

papers.title_en: MoCA4D: Monocular 3D Bounding Box Lifting and Tracking with Camera and Object Motion
papers.evidence: 单目视频中的三维框跟踪
papers.tldr: 针对单目视频三维边界框跟踪中物体运动与相机视角变化相互耦合、逐帧提升加时序滤波难以显式分离运动成分的问题，本文提出MoCA4D框架。该方法设置观测分支估计每帧几何，动态分支预测跨对象共享的相机变换与每个对象的刚体变换，并利用Star优化结合历史框精化当前深度和朝向。精化后的框再用于引导后续跟踪。该工作为视频目标跟踪中的三维运动建模与长期跟踪提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Monocular 3D bounding box tracking must account for both object motion and changes in camera viewpoint. Framewise box lifting with temporal filtering leaves these motion components implicit, while static-scene fusion assumes stationary objects. We introduce MoCA4D, a framework for 3D box lifting and tracking from monocular video, associated 2D box prompts, and camera intrinsics. An observation branch estimates per-frame geometry, while a dynamic branch predicts a camera transformation shared across objects and a separate rigid transformation for each object. We propose Star Optimization to refine current depth and orientation using the observation and historical boxes propagated through these transformations. The refined box then guides subsequent propagation. Across all evaluated objects in Argoverse 2 and ADT, Star Optimization reduces center motion error by 38.1% and 38.7%, respectively, relative to Kalman filtering of the same observations. On MOVi-F, the dynamic branch achieves the lowest corner and rotation errors and the highest IoU among the evaluated methods over eight-transition motion windows. Real-data camera-only controls further link predicted object motion to improved localization on dynamic-object tracks.

papers.title_en: Towards Deep Learning-Based Linear Assignment Problem Solvers for Multi-Object Tracking
papers.authors: Chu Tam Vu, Tran Thi Thuy Quynh, Do Hai Son
papers.evidence: 面向视频多目标跟踪数据关联的深度学习求解器
papers.tldr: 针对多目标跟踪中经典匈牙利算法在数据关联上的局限，本文提出并评估基于深度学习的线性分配问题求解器。作者设计代价矩阵嵌入，使单一模型可处理任意尺寸的代价矩阵，从而适应视频中目标数量随时间变化的情形，并比较了CNN、GNN与GLAN三种模型。仿真实验表明该嵌入提升了CNN与GNN的求解精度，而GLAN取得最高准确率。该工作为视频多目标跟踪的关联模块提供了可学习的替代方案。
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes and evaluates deep learning (DL)-based linear assignment problem (LAP) solvers as a replacement for the classical Hungarian algorithm in multi-object tracking (MOT) systems. Three representative neural models are studied, namely a convolutional network (CNN), a graph neural network (GNN), and the graph-based linear assignment network (GLAN). A cost-matrix embedding is introduced so that a single model operates on cost matrices of any size, as required in MOT where the number of objects varies over time, without training a separate model for each input shape. Extensive simulations show that the embedding improves the accuracy of the neural solvers (i.e., CNN and GNN), while GLAN attains the best accuracy among them. These solvers are then integrated into a generalized labeled multi-Bernoulli (GLMB) tracker and evaluated on the WILDTRACK dataset, where GLAN yields tracking accuracy close to the Hungarian reference and comparable to recent DL-based trackers.

papers.title_en: Attack-Inference Aligned Universal Adversarial Attacks on Video Object Segmentation
papers.authors: Ruiqi Shen, Chang Liu, Henghui Ding
papers.evidence: 对齐两阶段范式的视频目标分割通用对抗攻击
papers.tldr: 现有针对视频目标分割的对抗攻击往往忽视其目标初始化与记忆传播两阶段结构，导致攻击效率受限。本文提出AUV框架，通过解耦训练分别针对初始化与传播阶段优化通用对抗扰动，并破坏共享记忆空间以实现跨掩码、点、框与语言等多种提示的通用攻击。实验表明该方法在多个VOS模型上达到当前最优的攻击效果，揭示了分割模型的结构性脆弱点。
papers.abstract_en: Modern video object segmentation (VOS) relies on a two-stage inference paradigm: target initialization and memory-based propagation. However, existing adversarial attacks on VOS often overlook this structure. To bridge this gap, we propose AUV, an adversarial framework that Aligns with the Universal two-stage paradigm of VOS models. Specifically, AUV optimizes a universal adversarial perturbation (UAP) through decoupled training strategies tailored for both initialization and propagation stages. By disrupting the shared memory space, it achieves prompt-agnostic attacks across different modalities, including masks, points, boxes, and language. Extensive experiments show that AUV establishes state-of-the-art VOS attack performance, such as degrading mask-based SAM3 to only 8.4 J&F on DAVIS17-val (compared to 55.4 for the previous SOTA under the same training setup). It also exhibits superior temporal dynamics with the fastest onset, the most enduring persistence, and the support of any-time mid-video attacks. The AUV optimization framework is applicable to different VOS models, revealing vulnerabilities in real-world streaming VOS. Code is available at https://github.com/FudanCVL/AUV.

papers.title_en: INCISE: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation of Surgical Videos
papers.authors: Yifan Xu, Bofang Zheng, Guangyu Meng, Nishchal Sapkota, Xianshi Ma, Xu Cao, Tianjiao Yu, Danny Z Chen
papers.evidence: 面向手术视频的免训练视频目标分割
papers.tldr: 手术视频分析中的视频目标分割通常依赖大量专家标注进行微调，成本高昂。INCISE提出免训练的上下文分割框架，从多段手术视频中挑选多样化的无标注帧作为参考，缓解随机采样导致的视角偏差。实验表明该方法能更好地分割瞬时器械与细小结构，为低成本手术视频分割提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Surgical video analysis requires video object segmentation (VOS), yet existing methods are commonly based on pretrained model fine-tuning using a large number of expert labels. In-context segmentation (ICS) offers the promise of bypassing this high cost by segmenting a target video using a few annotated references, which are the sole source of surgical knowledge for a frozen model. However, existing ICS methods tend to draw such references at random, which concentrate on a few views that dominate a surgical video and can miss other objects of interest (e.g., transient instruments and small structures). To address these challenges, we propose INCISE, a training-free ICS framework for surgical videos. INCISE selects unlabeled frames from multiple surgical videos that jointly cover the local appearances of a target video, and then segments the target video using these references. With only 1.7% of training frames selected and annotated as references and no target video frame labeled, INCISE obtains 67.2% mean mIoU and outperforms the best SOTA fine-tuned method by 9.2 points. We hope INCISE can help establish ICS as a practical alternative to fine-tuning in surgical video analysis and other domains with a costly labeling burden.

papers.title_en: TrajRealm: A Large-Scale Point Tracking Dataset with Diverse Dynamics
papers.authors: Ni Yang, Weiguang Zhao, Jiafei Cao, Yankai Jiang, Haoyu Guo, Tao Yang, Chunhua Shen, Junting Dong
papers.evidence: 面向视频的大规模点跟踪数据集
papers.tldr: 现有通用点跟踪模型缺乏同时具备丰富动态内容、准确场景几何和足够规模的大规模训练数据。本文构建TrajRealm数据集，从现代游戏与具身仿真中采集千万帧级视频，覆盖多样目标、活动与交互，并提供RGB观测、深度、相机参数以及持续2D和3D点轨迹。该数据集为点跟踪模型的训练与评测提供几何一致的大规模标注，可推动视频序列中运动目标跟踪研究。
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose point tracking requires large-scale training data with diverse dynamics, yet existing datasets struggle to combine rich dynamic content, accurate scene geometry, and sufficient scale. We introduce TrajRealm, the first public synthetic point-tracking dataset to reach the ten-million-frame scale, constructed from games and embodied simulations. TrajRealm uses the rich environments and motion systems of modern games to capture diverse targets, activities, and interactions across diverse worlds, while embodied simulations add robot manipulation and indoor navigation data. The dataset provides RGB observations, depth, camera parameters, and persistent 2D and 3D point trajectories. These annotations provide precise, geometrically consistent supervision across foreground objects and static environmental surfaces. We also build TrajRealm-Bench with eight subcategories under Interaction and Locomotion to evaluate tracking across diverse scenes. Benchmark evaluations reveal the strengths and limitations of existing trackers in handling complex motion and maintaining long-term point correspondences. Training on TrajRealm improves the performance of existing tracking methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.

papers.title_en: MoGe-4D: Efficient, Flexible, and Unified Dense 4D Reconstruction and Tracking
papers.authors: Ruicheng Wang, Linlin Xin, Sicheng Xu, Jianfeng Xiang, Zelong Lv, Yu Deng, Yue Dong, Guangzhong Sun, Tong Zhang, Jiaolong Yang
papers.evidence: 从RGB视频统一进行稠密4D重建与点跟踪
papers.tldr: 从RGB视频重建动态场景需同时推理三维几何与跨视角运动，已有方法要么把重建与跟踪拆成碎片化流程，要么稠密时空解码代价过高。本文提出MoGe-4D，用成对的全局与自中心动态点图有序查询统一几何与运动预测，可在闭式解下恢复相对相机位姿，并支持深度、动态配准与稠密3D跟踪。通过解耦场景建模与查询解码，方法实现了高效稠密查询。该工作为视频中的稠密三维跟踪提供了统一高效框架。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic scenes from RGB video requires reasoning about both 3D geometry and motion across viewpoints, yet existing methods either split reconstruction and tracking into fragmented pipelines or face prohibitive dense spatiotemporal decoding costs. We introduce MoGe-4D, a feed-forward framework that unifies geometry and motion prediction via ordered queries of paired allocentric and egocentric dynamic point maps. Each query maps source pixels to a target time simultaneously in both camera frames, resolving relative camera pose in closed form while flexibly serving depth, dynamic registration, and dense 3D tracking. For efficient dense querying, MoGe-4D decouples scene modeling from query decoding: a high-capacity context encoder caches coarse global spatiotemporal features once, while a lightweight query encoder rapidly decodes dense point maps at flexible resolutions. Furthermore, as supervising dense 4D queries demands continuous 3D correspondences whose raw trajectory storage is prohibitive, we introduce RigIDTrack, a synthetic data pipeline and dataset that compresses surface dynamics into rigidity-regularized affine bodies, recovering exact arbitrary-frame 3D trajectories with $\sim15\%$ storage overhead over RGB-D video. Across diverse benchmarks, MoGe-4D achieves state-of-the-art dense 3D tracking, matches dedicated 3D foundation models in reconstruction, and runs substantially faster than prior 4D baselines.

papers.title_en: 3D Tracking Any Point with Events and Frames
papers.authors: Roberto Pellerito, Zijia Dai, Laurent Kneip, Davide Scaramuzza
papers.evidence: 融合事件相机与RGB帧在视频中跟踪2D和3D任意点
papers.tldr: 快速运动点在RGB帧模糊或帧间隔过大时难以在3D中跟踪，事件相机则能记录帧间亮度变化填补时间空隙。本文提出TrackAnyMotion，将单目RGB帧与事件流结合，在2D和3D中跟踪任意点，并用独立运动解码器融合几何运动线索、事件引导与2D轨迹进行迭代细化。作者还构建了高频3D轨迹的合成RGB-事件数据集HyperEvent。该工作拓展了视频点跟踪在高速与无帧时刻的适用性。
papers.abstract_en: Tracking a fast-moving point in 3D is prohibitive when RGB frames are blurred or too far apart to reveal its motion. Event cameras record brightness changes between frames, providing measurements inside these temporal gaps. We introduce TrackAnyMotion, which combines monocular RGB frames and events to track arbitrary points in 2D and 3D, including at times when no RGB frame is available. The motion expected for a static point, given scene geometry and camera motion, provides a reference for identifying independently moving objects. An independent-motion decoder combines geometric motion cues with event guidance and 2D tracks, feeding its predictions back into iterative 2D and 3D refinement. We also introduce HyperEvent, a synthetic RGB--Event dataset with high-frequency 3D trajectories, geometry, and independent-motion labels. At RGB frame timestamps on this benchmark, TrackAnyMotion reduces 3D and 2D endpoint errors by 70\% and 32\%, respectively.

papers.title_en: Recall4D: Forgetting, Not Misalignment, Limits Long-Horizon Feed-Forward 4D Reconstruction
papers.evidence: 面向视频序列的长时序点轨迹跟踪与持久世界状态建模
papers.tldr: 前馈4D跟踪器能从短片段恢复相机运动、深度与点轨迹，但在长视频上分窗串联会显著退化。作者发现误差增长主要源于遗忘：对已不再观测的静态点反复预测会破坏已恢复的几何，而非窗口间对齐失配。仅保留未观测点的最近位置即可在PointOdyssey上降低26%误差。为此提出免训练的Recall4D框架，为冻结跟踪器增加持久世界状态。该发现重新定位了长时序4D跟踪的关键瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 4D trackers recover camera motion, depth, and point trajectories from short video clips, but chaining windows over long videos degrades their accuracy. We find that replacing inter-window alignment with ground-truth transforms leaves tracking error essentially unchanged. Static-point error instead grows with time since last observation: repeatedly predicting a static point from windows that no longer observe it corrupts previously recovered geometry. We call this failure forgetting. Merely retaining the last observed positions of unseen points reduces error by 26% on PointOdyssey without modifying the tracker. We introduce Recall4D, a training-free framework that augments a frozen tracker with a persistent world state and sparse motion anchors. Static points retain their world-space positions outside the camera view and are refined by averaging observations decoded at sparse keyframes while in view. For dynamic objects, the tracker decodes sparse representative anchors, while geometric skinning propagates their displacements to dense queries. Across two long-horizon benchmarks, Recall4D improves the accuracy of its backbone while running 7.6-9.0$\times$ faster, and its accuracy gains carry over to five further backbones and three other long-sequence tasks, demonstrating its generality.

papers.title_en: Tracking Any Point with Agentic Visual Reasoning
papers.authors: Xuweiyi Chen, Jin Yao, Linzhan Mou, Lei Gong, Di Liu, Cheng Zhang, Ziqiao Ma, Sihan Xu, Adam W. Harley, Shengyi Qian, Zezhou Cheng
papers.evidence: 视觉语言模型智能体在视频中跟踪任意点
papers.tldr: 通用视觉语言模型在像素级点对应上表现不佳，因为需要在目标外观变化甚至消失重现后仍持续定位同一物理表面点。本文提出AgenTAP，让视觉语言模型作为智能体直接预测点坐标与可见性，并自主决定查看哪些区域、利用所得证据校验点身份并迭代修正预测。搭配GPT-6 Astra时，该方法在点跟踪基准上超过专门的专家视觉模型。该工作表明智能体式主动推理可把通用视觉模型拓展到细粒度视频对应任务。
papers.abstract_en: A general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) has surpassed expert vision models in many domains such as object detection and video recognition. However, point correspondence is known to be challenging for VLMs since it goes beyond object-level recognition: it requires pixel-level localization of the same physical surface point across observations, even when appearance changes or the point disappears and later reappears. In this paper, we introduce AgenTAP, a VLM-based agent that directly predicts point coordinates and visibility and actively reasons over videos. Starting from its own estimate, the agent autonomously chooses what to inspect and uses the resulting evidence to verify point identity and refine its predictions. With GPT-6 Astra, it surpasses expert vision models in both point localization and visibility prediction, without correspondence-specific fine-tuning. We further use AgenTAP to re-identify physical points after disappearance and reconnect fragmented tracks, constructing EgoTAP-4D, a dataset of 3D point trajectories in long real-world egocentric videos. On sampled reappearing points, its predictions approach human agreement, and adding EgoTAP-4D to D4RT training improves average 3D tracking performance.
